title: How to Fix Separated and Backward Arabic Font Rendering in Adobe Creative Suite
excerpt: A technical troubleshooting guide for creative professionals to rectify broken, isolated, and inverted Arabic characters in Photoshop and Premiere Pro.
targetKeyword: photoshop arabic text backward fix, adobe illustrator broken arabic letters, fix arabic text premiere pro 2026, indesign disconnected glyphs error
content:
Graphic designers, UI/UX engineers, and web development professionals deploying production localized assets frequently run into a disruptive layout rendering limitation within the Adobe Creative Suite ecosystem — specifically Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, and InDesign. This issue manifests as broken, completely isolated Arabic characters that fail to connect cursive glyphs natively, alongside an inverted layout structure that forces strings to flow incorrectly from Left-to-Right (LTR) instead of the natural Right-to-Left (RTL) progression.

The good news is that Adobe has progressively improved its Arabic support. Starting with Photoshop 23.0 (October 2021), Adobe introduced a unified text engine that handles Arabic, Hebrew, and other complex scripts more seamlessly than older versions — but you still need to know the correct configuration switches to activate it fully.

Engineering Diagnostic: This layout malfunction does not indicate a corrupt font file or a broken installation. It highlights a missing configuration inside Adobe's native typesetting core, which defaults to a Latin text rendering engine unequipped to process complex multi-byte bidirectional (BiDi) character matrices. The same root cause applies across Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, and InDesign — which is why the fix is nearly identical across all four applications.

The Technical Architecture of Complex Bidirectional Layout Engines

To fully grasp why characters fragment, one must examine how text engines process typography files. Standard software packages rely on layout engines optimized for Western alphabets. These systems render font glyphs as standalone geometric entities positioned sequentially along an incremental baseline. However, Semitic languages operate on a dynamic contextual typesetting framework. Each Arabic character changes its geometric form based on its exact positioning within a word — shifting through four distinct typographic states: Initial, Medial, Final, and Isolated.

When raw Arabic text strings are pasted directly into a default Western text layer, the engine lacks the behavioral logic to compute these dynamic cursive transitions. Furthermore, encoding mismatches across operating systems — such as injecting a UTF-8 string into a legacy platform layout — exacerbate the rendering degradation. For a deeper technical understanding of this, the Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm (UAX #9) is the definitive specification that governs how all compliant rendering engines should handle mixed-direction text. This breaks the text flow into an unreadable sequence of disconnected symbols, instantly compromising your design's authority and professional look.

Comprehensive Manual Reconfiguration Blueprint for All Adobe Layout Engines

If you possess local administration rights on your workstation and want to establish a permanent, system-wide solution to fix photoshop arabic text backward issues and eliminate adobe illustrator broken arabic letters across your entire workflow, execute the following configuration steps for each application:

Application PlatformRequired Preference PathLayout Engine Target SettingNotes
Adobe Photoshop (pre-v23)Edit → Preferences → TypeSwitch to World-Ready LayoutRequires full restart
Adobe Photoshop (v23+)Type → Language OptionsEnable Middle Eastern FeaturesAuto-appears in Properties panel
Adobe IllustratorPreferences → TypeEnable Show Indic OptionsUnlocks RTL paragraph tools
Adobe Premiere ProPreferences → GraphicsSelect South Asian & Middle EasternApply to Essential Graphics panel
Adobe InDesignEdit → Preferences → TextWorld-Ready Paragraph ComposerAlso set Story Direction to RTL

After applying these settings, save your changes, close the application, and restart the software to flush the memory layout cache. When you create a new text bounding box, make sure to set the paragraph alignment toggle to Right-to-Left. For premium screen presentation, pair this configuration with professional Arabic web fonts like Cairo or Tajawal — both available free on Google Fonts — to guarantee flawless readability on high-DPI displays. Programmatic Automation: Headless Text Reshaping for Server-Side Pipelines

In automated enterprise workflows — such as generating personalized marketing banners, OG social preview cards, or certificate images on a headless server without a graphical user interface (GUI) — you cannot change layout engines manually. Developers must sanitize and preprocess text data streams programmatically using a reshaping script before feeding strings into rendering contexts like HTML5 Canvas or Node-based SVG builders. This is one of the most common causes of the fix arabic text premiere pro 2026 and indesign disconnected glyphs error issues reported in CI/CD environments. Below is an efficient JavaScript utility designed to reorder character arrays for non-localized graphics engines:

/**
 * Pre-processes and reshapes Arabic text fields for legacy canvas graphics targets.
 * Handles word-level reversal to maintain correct visual BiDi flow on
 * rendering engines that don't natively support RTL text direction.
 * @param {string} inputString - The raw, disconnected Arabic text input.
 * @return {string} The transformed, correctly ordered string pipeline.
 */
function reshapeBidirectionalText(inputString) {
  if (!inputString || typeof inputString !== 'string') return '';
 
  // Tokenize the input string by splitting on whitespace boundaries
  const segmentWords = inputString.trim().split(/\s+/);
 
  // Invert the internal glyph array to maintain correct visual flow
  const transformedSegments = segmentWords.map(token => {
    return token.split('').reverse().join('');
  });
 
  // Re-join in reversed word order for full sentence RTL correction
  return transformedSegments.reverse().join(' ');
}
 
// --- Verification Routine ---
const legacySample = "منصة تيكست عربي";
console.log("Processed Stream:", reshapeBidirectionalText(legacySample));
// Expected: correct RTL-ready string for canvas injection

Font Selection for Arabic Rendering: What Actually Works

Even after enabling the correct layout engine, poor font choice can still produce suboptimal results. Arabic fonts designed for print (like traditional Nastaliq styles) often render poorly on screen at small sizes. For digital work, prioritize fonts in the .woff2 format with confirmed OpenType GDEF tables that define proper glyph contextual alternates. The four most reliable choices for digital Arabic design in 2026 are Cairo (geometric), Tajawal (humanist), Noto Naskh Arabic (text-body), and IBM Plex Arabic (technical interfaces). Frequently Asked Questions: Adobe Arabic Text Rendering

Does this fix work on Adobe Creative Cloud subscription versions? Yes — the preference paths described apply to all CC versions from 2019 onward. Why does my Arabic text look correct in Word but break in Photoshop? Microsoft Office uses the Windows Uniscribe engine which handles BiDi natively; Adobe uses its own proprietary engine which requires manual activation. Can I script the preference change via ExtendScript? Yes — you can use app.preferences.typePrefs in Photoshop's scripting API to toggle the layout engine programmatically across a batch of documents.
